Hi Kruger, You are really on fire my friend! Keep it up!

I apologize in advance if you've mentioned this before, but I am fascinated with the way you trade QMs, so much so, that I intend to study them again, but a little more intensely this time.

Cheers Aaron

author: Kruger
text:
Aaron wrote: Hi Kruger, You are really on fire my friend! Keep it up!

I apologize in advance if you've mentioned this before, but I am fascinated with the way you trade QMs, so much so, that I intend to study them again, but a little more intensely this time.

My question is this, when you take a QM setup, Do you always take them at HTF SD or SR?

Cheers Aaron Hi Aaron, I am looking for QM setups in reactive places like SDs or SRs but time frame is more like indication of what can I get from trade in terms of pips.

In other words HTFs = safe(er) and good R:R, LTF = TTs for quick scalps. Of course there's still difference between trading QMs for reversal and with HTF trend where you can take good pips from 1M QM. As you can see topic is rather broad and opened for customization.

author: Aaron
text:
Hi K, Thanks for the reply, When I was doing my study of QMs, I don't think I gave this concept enough thought, today, I have done a very basic test on the tester using 4hr SD zones only, once price reaches the zone, I would then switch to the 30/15 min and look for the set up, and it was very high probability.

I will put in some more work towards this and see if I can use it next week on some of my demo trades.

Aaron
